title: TSLPR expression marks a functionally discrete subset of human monocytes elicited by TLR4 activation.
description: TSLPR+ and TSLPR- monocytes were isolated form 3 adult healthy donors and stimulated with LPS. RNA-sequencing has been performed using Illumina technology.

samples.title: Exp0222A1_TSLPRminus
samples.description: Protocols: Cells were isolated from buffy coats of healthy donors. Blood was layered onto Histopaque-1077 (Sigma) and mononuclear cells were collected at the interface. CD14+ monocytes were further purified from mononuclear cells with CD14 Microbeads (Miltenyi Biotec) and cultured for 14 hours with 10 ng/ml LPS (E. coli O26:B6, Sigma) in complete IMDM-5 (IMDM, 5% FCS, 1x non essential amino acids, 1x UltraGlutamine, 25 mM HEPES, 5 ug/ml gentamicin [Lonza]). Then, cells were stained with anti-TSLPR-APC (eBioscience, clone eBio1A6, dilution 1:20) in PBS+10% human AB serum+0.05% sodium azide for 30 minutes at 4°C, and FACS-sorted into TSLPR- and TSLPR+ monocytes using BD FACSARIA III (BD Biosciences). 100000 cells from each subset were further stimulated for 14 hours with 10 ng/ml LPS in complete IMDM-5. Cells were harvested and RNA extracted using ReliaPrep RNA Cell Miniprep System (Promega). RNA was extracted from LPS-stimulated TSLPR- and TSLPR+ monocytes using ReliaPrep RNA Cell Miniprep System (Promega) and DNA was eliminated by DNase treatment according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Quality and quantity of RNA was assessed by NanoDrop (Thermo-Fisher) and Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies). Indexed libraries were prepared from 1 ug/ea purified RNA with TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit (Illumina) according to the manufacturer's instructions. Libraries were quantified using the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies) and pooled such that each index-tagged sample was present in equimolar amounts, with final concentration of the pooled samples of 2nM.
